description: Human working-mode lifecycle across the 6-phase factory CBPA experiment. LEGISLATOR (sets cross-cell contract and variant routing) → AUDITOR (monitors disturbances and operator absence) → PARTNER (co-decides escalation option) → AUDITOR (reviews stabilised factory state) → LEGISLATOR (shift-close: L5 learning feeds L1, rewrites C3_factory and pre-stages FS4 for next shift).
